scope: Initial source-unit inventory only; no D geometry safety claimed

rows.primary: face-local lyric, face labels, alternate copy and numeral
rows.strategy: face yaw/pitch and pop intervals; chunk/face schedule

rows.primary: front lyric rows, deliberate secondary text rings and optional band/glass
rows.strategy: front arc pitch/row spacing; bounded spin, ring text and shear

rows.primary: each card face, corner rank and lyric glyph
rows.strategy: card pitch/row arrangement; flip intervals

rows.primary: each folded panel and printed glyph
rows.strategy: fold pitch/depth; bounded affine panels

rows.primary: cloth strips and printed glyphs
rows.strategy: wave amplitude/path and line pitch; strip shear

rows.primary: ribbon path, edge and printed glyphs
rows.strategy: path bend, path measure and text spacing

rows.primary: strings, weights/fan papers and printed text
rows.strategy: anchor pitch and string length; angular sweep

rows.primary: each falling/settled glyph
rows.strategy: settled row/column pitch; entry and exit glyph intervals

rows.primary: each block face, edges and printed glyph
rows.strategy: block pitch and row arrangement; projected fall

rows.primary: glyph balloons, highlights and tied strings
rows.strategy: balloon pitch and string length; buoyant sweep

rows.primary: lyric magnets plus decoy magnet bodies
rows.strategy: magnet row pitch; source attraction/rotation

rows.primary: letter tile, face glyph and point value
rows.strategy: tile pitch and rows; affine entry/exit

rows.primary: sign body, shadow, rim bulbs, lyric and subtitle
rows.strategy: sign writing measure and rim pitch; pop interval

rows.primary: module housing, main scrolling lyric and information strip
rows.strategy: display lane/width; clipped source scroll and dot texture

rows.primary: board, structure, lamps and lyric/tag
rows.strategy: board writing field and post geometry; rise interval

rows.primary: hero bubble and lyric; crowd captions retain separate roles
rows.strategy: hero writing field and bubble tail; crowd intervals

rows.primary: grid, clue labels, numbers, crossing entries and lyric cells
rows.strategy: grid cell measure and clue arrangement; typed writing clocks

rows.primary: grid panel, find capsule, path glyphs and metadata
rows.strategy: grid cell pitch and find-path direction; decoy capsule separate
rows.tiledAux: seeded off-path kana filler and earlier decoy capsule

rows.primary: jigsaw pieces, their clipped lyric portions and seams
rows.strategy: piece grid measure and arrival paths; clip union

rows.primary: solid lyric, affine cast lyric and shared floor/lamp
rows.strategy: light direction and cast extent; wall blur needs finite support

rows.primary: central disc/band and complete lyric
rows.strategy: hero writing field and disc radius; repeated radial background deferred
rows.tiledAux: 6..12 clipped sectors each repeat five radial background captions; complete hero lyric is separately protected

rows.primary: each domino face, pips and printed glyph
rows.strategy: domino row pitch and fall angle; per-piece phases

rows.primary: burst plate and complete printed lyric
rows.strategy: ray proportions and writing field; plate motion

rows.primary: every lens-scaled primary glyph and lens markers
rows.strategy: lens position/strength and glyph pitch; interval scale

rows.primary: projected wall surfaces and complete front lyric
rows.strategy: wall depth, face writing measure and perspective

rows.primary: folded sheet faces, creases and printed lyric
rows.strategy: sheet aspect and writing measure; fold topology

rows.primary: teeth, pull tab and revealed primary lyric
rows.strategy: zip path and tooth pitch; reveal clip

rows.primary: all clipped glyph slices and extrusion copies
rows.strategy: slice pitch and extrusion depth; clip/offset intervals

rows.primary: all source glyph fragments and glitch cells
rows.strategy: cell displacement and reveal intervals; source coverage

rows.primary: lit tiles, bevels and mask cells construct primary lyric
rows.strategy: primary glyph tile pitch; offscreen sampler is provenance
rows.provenance: Offscreen text raster is a primary construction input; final tiles/screened output are the stage ink.

rows.primary: primary glyph including pattern/texture and rim
rows.strategy: glyph writing measure; repeated texture stays primary fill
rows.provenance: Repeated texture is an input inside the primary glyph, never auxiliary stage text.

rows.primary: first lyric glyph rings/fill, complete lyric and meaningful metadata
rows.strategy: contour radius/spacing and side writing field; raw stroke bounds

rows.primary: screened primary glyph and optional offset duo copy
rows.strategy: screen pitch and primary glyph measure; alpha sampler provenance
rows.provenance: Offscreen text raster is a primary construction input; final tiles/screened output are the stage ink.

rows.primary: bridged primary glyph, marks, overspray and drips
rows.strategy: stencil field and spray path; evenodd clip topology
